items.title: The algebraic induction step: flatness of a localised module over a flat finitely presented ring map with geometrically integral fibres
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the algebraic induction step over a local base: for a finitely presented flat ring map with geometrically integral fibres and a finite module, it produces a map from a finite free module that is an isomorphism on the special fibre, and shows that flatness of the localisation at a prime over the maximal ideal is equivalent to four conditions involving universal injectivity of that map and flatness of its cokernel (statement lines 2355-2379, tag 05I3). The substantive part is the implication from flatness to universal injectivity, which needs the local universal injectivity criterion, the non Noetherian projectivity lemma, permanence and localisation of universal injectivity and flatness of the cokernel; the rest of the cycle is closed with Nakayama's lemma and a nonzerodivisor statement. The first implication is the substance, so the claim is H2.
